newsitem.title: USA: Ajay Sports gets $34 million facility.
newsitem.headline: Ajay Sports gets $34 million facility.

text.p: Ajay Sports Inc said Tuesday it arranged a new $34 million bank facility, providing capital that the golf products and furniture maker needs to improve its performance.
The facility from Wells Fargo and Co was a joint loan arrangement between Ajay and Williams Controls Inc, which has a 19-percent stake in Ajay. The loan expires in June 2000.
At the closing of the loan, Ajay borrowed $7.5 million, and Williams borrowed $17 million, a spokesman for Williams said.

"This three-year commitment by Wells Fargo to Ajay should provide the company with the capital needed to continue to improve the performance of the Ajay companies," said Ajay chairman Thomas Itin in a statement.
He said Ajay Leisure Products, a mass market golf business, and the company's casual living outdoor furniture business, Leisure Life, are showing improved performance compared to last year.

"This new loan facility should give us the time and financial resources needed to continue the restructuring of our Palm Springs Golf operation, through the funding of new product development and working capital," Itin said.

The new loan includes a letter of credit facility as part of the revolving line of credit, and also incorporates an additional term loan facility based on the value of real estate, machinery and equipment. The two companies will share in the available credit under this new facility to fund new product development, working capital, capital expenditures and other uses, according to a press release issued by Ajay.
